name: evh_match
description: eVHarmony v2 (round 17c): is this candidate a real vesicle? yes (Match) / no (Nope) / dense (Small & dense: small, uniformly dark, no clear bilayer; possibly lipoproteins) / unsure (It's complicated). v1's values keep their names, so v1 answers carry over. Overlapping vesicles count as Match. kind (optional, only meaningful after Match): single / ml (multilayer) / mv (has vesicles inside) / inner (inside another). consent as in v1: answered once per reviewer, on the set's first item only.

object_attrs.label: Match?
object_attrs.help: Swipe right = Match (a membrane-bound vesicle, overlapping ones too), left = Nope, down = Small and dense, up = It's complicated.

object_attrs.label: What is it?
object_attrs.help: Only after a Match, optional: skip when you can't tell.

object_attrs.label: Count my answers
object_attrs.help: Asked once, on the set's first item: yes = these answers may be used.
